text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Stop! Stop right there, Friendbot X!
It's not accepting my inputs... It's gone completely berserk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
止まって！　
止まりなさいなかよしX！
こちらの操作も受け付けないし、
完全に暴走してるわね……！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
But the blueprints were perfect! What went wrong?
You did all follow them carefully, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
設計図は完璧だったはずなのに、
何故ですの？
ちゃんと設計図通りに作りましたわよね？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
N... nyaturally! It's just... you knyow!
Even with the same blueprints, everyone has their own interpretation!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もっ……
もちろんにゃ。
ただ、
アレにゃ！
同じ設計図でも
解釈の違いはどうしても生まれるものにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This isn't because of [i]that,[/i] is it? N-nyo, it couldn't be!
The other thing, then...? Nyo, it attached properly in the end.
Don't tell me it's [i]that?![/i]  But that's the most important feature!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
アレが原因にゃ？　
いや、
そんなわけないにゃ。
じゃあアレ……
でも
ちゃんとくっついたにゃ。
もしかしてアレにゃ！？　
でも
アレは絶対必要だったにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong, Tamaki?!
Your eyes are shifting back and forth as fast as lightning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしましたのタマキさん！？
目が
すごい勢いで泳いでいますわよ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
N-now, now, Akino!
Who cares about some silly blueprints, anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まぁまぁアキノさん。
どうでもいいじゃない、
設計図なんて。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
They don't know, do they? No, I'm sure they can't!
I took care to act while nobody was looking!
But I didn't think it would go berserk...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……バレてないわよね。
いや、
バレるわけないわ。
ちゃんと誰も見てない間に行動したもの。
でもまさか、
暴走するなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
How very strange.
That doesn't sound like you at all, Mifuyu.
Usually you're so attentive to details... Isn't she, Yukari?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……珍しいですわね。
ミフユさんがそんな風に言うなんて。
いつもだったら
もっと厳しいのに……
ねぇ、
ユカリさん？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-oh, ah... yes, that's true.
But you know, everybody gets a little careless sometimes...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
あ、
ああ……
そうですね。
でもほら、
誰にだって気が緩むときもありますよ……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
It's not my fault... is it? I don't recall anything.
Right. I don't have any memory of this at all,
so how could I possibly be to blame?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私じゃない……
わよね？
記憶にないもの。
うん。
記憶がすっぽり抜け落ちているんだから、
どう考えても私は
無関係なはずよ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
You all seem to be acting rather strangely...
But there's no time to worry about that!
We must work together to defeat Friendbot X!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにやら三人とも、
様子がおかしいですわね。
でも今はそれどころじゃありませんわ！
全員で
なかよしXを止めますわよ！
